prewrittenFacts.statement: Adil is the older brother and appears in the photograph.
Sami is the younger brother and took the photograph.
Uncle Nadeem lent the camera but was absent when the photograph was taken.
The photograph was taken in June 2010 outside the old house in Multan.
The yellow bicycle was borrowed, not a birthday present.

result.original: My older brother Adil appears in the photograph beside a yellow bicycle. My younger brother Sami took the photograph. Our uncle Nadeem lent Sami the camera, but he was not there when the picture was taken. It was June 2010, outside our old house in Multan. Adil borrowed the bicycle from a neighbour for that afternoon; it was never his birthday present. I stood behind Sami and held the camera case. Nobody in the photograph is holding the camera because Sami is on the other side of it. The print has a white stripe across one corner. My mother wrote both brothers' names on the back, without explaining their different roles. When I found it years later, Sami reminded me who had pressed the shutter.
